occurrenceModel.mechanism: Occurrence paths (e.g. 'ROOT/SUB_01/BOLT_03') maintain independent 4x4 coordinate frames while sharing underlying component definitions.

mateAndConstraintSolving.solverMethod: Iterative numerical relaxation with constraint error residuals (tolerance 1e-6)

degreesOfFreedomAndKinematics.solverMethod: Forward kinematic propagation and Jacobian-based velocity/displacement solving

collisionAndInterferenceDetection.mechanism: Broad-phase AABB tree bounding checks followed by narrow-phase triangle-triangle intersection tests

assemblyAssociativityAndRegeneration.mechanism: When an instance CAD part undergoes parameter mutation (e.g. depth 25 -> 35 in P5-001), DocumentEvaluator re-evaluates the solid, rebinds the topology reference via persistent tags (CapEnd), updates mate positions, and notifies PLM.
